tuples.subject: penal_charges
tuples.special_circumstance: no upper limit/cap for penal charges has been prescribed
tuples.quote: Although no upper limit / cap for penal charges has been prescribed, the bank, while formulating its policy on penal charges, should keep in mind that the intent of levying penal charges is essentially to inculcate a sense of credit discipline and such charges are not meant to be used as a revenue enhancement tool.
